notes.title: Just In Time For Halloween, Spooky Mystery Whodunit Is Now Live!
notes.content:
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6138946/bfafed816a6a7903571576b1dcf456bb986b04af.png

Put your detective hat on and solve the untimely murder of a famous video game designer.

A fabulously wealthy game designer is found dead outside his castle in rural Vermont, and soon evidence shows that this was not merely a freak accident attributed to local superstition. Now it's up to you to investigate the murder and apprehend the guilty. Play as unlikely partners -- ace sleuth Detective Guy and Cleo, the clue-sniffing dog to explore the castle grounds, search for clues, and question suspects. Can you solve the case?

 Murder mystery whodunit
 Play as a detective and dog crime-solving team
 Explore the area and look for clues
 Interview suspects and make deductions
 Solve the case and apprehend the guilty

“I’m excited to share “Murder Is Game Over” with gamers and mystery fans everywhere. I hope players enjoy the exploration mechanics, spooky atmosphere, and classically-inspired whodunit story,” said Matthew of HitherYon Games. 

Murder Is Game Over is 20% off until November 1. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1940090/Murder_Is_Game_Over

notes.title: Meridian4 News - Paladin Dream Black Friday / Holiday Season Game Update
notes.content:
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6138946/3e421082f02e384b8866abfb6791154835d79fae.gif

It’s been really enjoyable and inspirational to watch players stream Paladin Dream. It feels like playing God and watching people explore the world I created, and I also get to see which parts are celebrated, and where the game could be better or less confusing. I’ve gotten lots of positive feedback about the story, and I wanted to focus this update on showing more information about the world.

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6138946/68383540a8f4929bdc3e0e8b334b9fa0d5874187.jpg

The demon worshiping cult is malicious, reclusive, and possesses black magic to keep outsiders away. I wanted to show the extent to which they’ve gone to protect their temple (which was crudely dug out of a city wall). In the update, Josiah explores an MC Escher-like looping room and a hallucination that projects his fear. This dungeon is intended to be full of creepy traps. The fortune-teller in Nazarfang encounter is also expanded a bit, to give the player some early insight into the 3 different religions and how they interact.

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6138946/ee311ab4446d59c7fb1787b30db4574ce13d5b02.png

The northern wilderness is an area that is mostly not settled, and wild animals have free reign. Organized religion does not have much influence here. I created a new encounter where Josiah spars with another adventurer and their wild animal companion. There’s also a new battle with Josiah’s Reflection (think Link’s Shadow in Zelda games) that requires a bit of logic to win. To ease a side quest that involves a decent amount of backtracking, and I added a way for Josiah to jump down the mountain with a certain item. Making it to the top of Starcross Peak requires Josiah to leave civilization behind and examine his beliefs from a different perspective.

I fixed some minor bugs including dialog, art, and game balance. When you reach a new level, there is also a new common event that fires to tell the player to check and see if they’ve learned a new spell. Hopefully, this will lead to players realizing there are multiple ways to manage their resources. It’s great to get feedback and continue expanding the game.

Hope everyone has a wonderful holiday season and thanks for supporting Paladin Dream!

Matthew

p.s. If you've read this far and haven't yet added Paladin Dream to your wishlist, now is your chance :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1592120/Paladin_Dream/

notes.title: Black Friday / Holiday Season Game Update
notes.content:
It’s been really enjoyable and inspirational to watch players stream Paladin Dream. It feels like playing God and watching people explore the world I created, and I also get to see which parts are celebrated, and where the game could be better or less confusing. I’ve gotten lots of positive feedback about the story, and I wanted to focus this update on showing more information about the world.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40226109/d734eed2eb569809d5c789ca6cf70b6983d8ad7c.jpg

The demon worshiping cult is malicious, reclusive, and possesses black magic to keep outsiders away. I wanted to show the extent to which they’ve gone to protect their temple (which was crudely dug out of a city wall). In the update, Josiah explores an MC Escher-like looping room and a hallucination that projects his fear. This dungeon is intended to be full of creepy traps. The fortune-teller in Nazarfang encounter is also expanded a bit, to give the player some early insight into the 3 different religions and how they interact. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40226109/ee311ab4446d59c7fb1787b30db4574ce13d5b02.png

The northern wilderness is an area that is mostly not settled, and wild animals have free reign. Organized religion does not have much influence here. I created a new encounter where Josiah spars with another adventurer and their wild animal companion. There’s also a new battle with Josiah’s Reflection (think Link’s Shadow in Zelda games) that requires a bit of logic to win. To ease a side quest that involves a decent amount of backtracking, and I added a way for Josiah to jump down the mountain with a certain item. Making it to the top of Starcross Peak requires Josiah to leave civilization behind and examine his beliefs from a different perspective.

I fixed some minor bugs including dialog, art, and game balance. When you reach a new level, there is also a new common event that fires to tell the player to check and see if they’ve learned a new spell. Hopefully, this will lead to players realizing there are multiple ways to manage their resources. It’s great to get feedback and continue expanding the game, but also a bit troubling that a small minority of players are complaining about the game scope. This is a low-priced indie game, not a AAA title with a budget of millions of dollars. Paladin Dream was not intended to be an open-world MMORPG where you travel all over the globe performing repetitive quests. Bigger isn’t always better, and there are plenty of great games which are relatively short. Not every RPG needs or wants to be 100 hours long, and Paladin Dream places emphasis on storytelling over length.

Hope everyone has a wonderful holiday season and thanks for supporting Paladin Dream!

notes.title: Meridian4 News - The Dark Prophecy Game Update
notes.content:
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6138946/c0e5deda1c0f61c1b7df2dd7ba749478d5f4cfbb.gif

Can you hear the trumpets and the stomping of horses? It seems we are approaching the royal castle! This location is an important link in Jacob's journey to other places. And, as you can see for yourself - from here we have a way to the kitchen, to the servants' room, to the king's castle, and to the prison (and who knows which location we will find ourselves in next time!).

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6138946/c28150d01fd200af971c60bb58d0c9934ae9d72c.png

Here, for the first time, we meet the inhabitants of the castle - a bored and resting servant, a castle keeper, and a guard patrolling the wall.

At the moment, this location, like the previous "Castle Gates", is being added with minimal functionality.

The plan is to add all the planned content first, and only then polish the game and fill it with all the dialogue, adventure, and puzzles you need.

Sorry for the slow development speed - the artist and I are doing our best to release the game as soon as possible. And, although after the main work we only have evenings and weekends to work on the project, we will slowly but surely bring it to a happy end.

Thanks to everyone who continues to follow the project - you give us the strength to continue. Stay tuned! See you in the next updates!

Thanks for all your support!
Dennis

p.s. If you're reading this and still have not added The Dark Prophecy to your wishlist, now is your chance ːsteamhappyː

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1565680/The_Dark_Prophecy/

notes.title: Paladin Dream update - Temple of the Wilds
notes.content:
Paladin Dream is excited about offering FREE new content for the game at the end of August. The update includes a pagan / nature-themed dungeon with new enemies, items, a mini-game, and a bit of story. It also features new achievements and new music.

Several publishers I spoke with mentioned that they focus on post-release content updates as part of their publishing strategy. Since Paladin Dream has been gradually expanding from a minimum viable product, I’ve been generally comfortable with this idea. As a creator, I frequently think about what else would be fun to add to the game world, what stories could be told, and how to communicate the game’s themes more clearly.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40226109/cd4957ad342019d8f89d95e0029be9f04a2eb3da.gif

One of the main ideas in Paladin Dream is the interaction between religions. The story mostly focuses on the conflict between the paladin religion and the demon religion, but there is also a third religion, which is the nature religion. The nature religion is presented as neutral, but generally not explored much in the game. So this update allows the player to enter a nature / pagan theme dungeon concentrating on this religion with expanded content.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40226109/648b5ab14e751446b2223387c713879d485aa3dc.gif

The nature religion is generally ancient and a bit secretive, so the entrance to this dungeon is a little difficult to locate. You’ll need to have found a certain symbol of this religion, and then there is a new area with a book that details the whereabouts of the temple. Once you obtain this item and find a certain landmark on a map, you’ll be able to go inside the Temple of the Wilds.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40226109/3cc442c63be6240a4f923555ded6f40a1f1f1dd3.gif

One path inside the temple takes you to an optional boss battle. You might find that certain weapons or spells are not effective against this enemy, and have to figure out what type of attack will deal damage. (Hint: The paladin and demon religions don’t like each other, the nature religion is neutral.) When you win, you’ll unlock a unique armor, and learn more about the spirits of the old world.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40226109/5a98d133ef1b4d7555fe9db8f38f59a3e7c68f76.gif

Also in this dungeon is a meadow where you’ll have to catch a frantic, fast-moving fairy. It’s not easy, but with a bit of patience and luck, a new item to boost your magic stats will be your reward. Don’t forget to read the inscription on the statue to learn more about another character you’ve met earlier.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40226109/aeaabd137d524bfc410be2c1a6a8d1c9c413d20a.gif

Lastly, there is a store specializing in new nature / pagan goods with some worthwhile and useful items only available here. Wanted to remove a curse during battle? Here is your chance. Pick up some new supplies before continuing the adventure.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40226109/75e751ba5882c4d22f24737c6f6724fad4ceb77e.gif

Thanks for supporting the game, and have fun exploring the all-new Temple of the Wilds!
